data.1: THE CO-OPERATIVE BANK OF KENYA LIMITED AND SUBSIDIARIES Audited Financial Statements for the Year Ended 31 December 2011

data.item: PROPOSED DIVIDEND AND BONUS SHARE ISSUE The directors recommend payment of a dividend of KShs. 0.40 (2010 - KShs 0.40) for every ordinary share of KShs 1 held. The dividends will be paid on or about 22nd June 2012 to the shareholders registered on the Bank’s Register at the close of business on 28th May 2012. The register will remain closed for one day on 29th May 2012 for the preparation of dividend warrants. The directors have also approved and recommended a bonus share issue of one (1) share for every five (5) ordinary shares held. The bonus issue subject to Capital Markets Authority approval will be credited to the shareholders on the register as at close of business on 15th June 2012. None MESSAGE FROM THE DIRECTORS The above Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss account are extracts from the Bank's financial statements which have been audited by Ernst & Young and received an unqualified opinion. A full set of these financial statements will be available for inspection on our website www.co-opbank.co.ke and at our registered office at Co-operative House after approval by members at the Annual General Meeting. The financial statements were approved by the Board of Directors on 7th March 2012 and signed on its behalf by: - S.C. Muchiri, EBS - Group Chairman J. Riungu - Vice Chairman Dr. G. Muriuki, MBS - Group Managing Director & CEO R. M. Githaiga (Mrs.) - Company Secretary
